Interface MachinePlayer

@NonExtendable public interface MachinePlayer
Everything MachineEngine and its addons keep for one player (D37): values of registered PlayerDataKeys and PlayerSettings. Get it with MachineEngine.get().players().get(player).

Use it on the player's own thread (their entity scheduler on Folia), like a machine on its region. Reads and writes are safe from any thread, but two threads updating the same value race.
